propositions: The linter already detects attribute-form git wrapper calls (core._git, self._git, mod.run_git) via the ast.Attribute branch in _wrapper_name, but this behavior is undocumented and untested, making it appear absent to future maintainers.

All existing tests use only bare-name form (ast.Name); no tests exercise attribute receivers (self, nested, imported-module), leaving the attribute-form detection branch uncovered and vulnerable to accidental removal.

The gate correctly resolves argv for _ref_lock_push.py's push_lease_cas call and correctly does not fire because 'push' is not in MUTATION_VERBS, but this disposition is not explicitly pinned by any test.
The # raw-git-ok marker must continue to silence attribute-form calls exactly as it silences bare-form calls, and this requirement is not tested for the attribute case.
